items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 9.4.9 at source lines 693-703: for a functor F between precategories, being an isomorphism of precategories, admitting G with eta, eps satisfying the labelled triangle equation (9.4.10), and merely admitting such data, are equivalent. The 90-line proof is a three-way equivalence whose real content is (i)<->(ii): the first reduction turns the equation between equalities of functors into the object-level triangle identity (lines 708-714), the action of the inverse functor on hom-sets must then be manufactured by conjugating with idtoiso of the object-level isomorphism and inverting the fully faithful F (lines 718-723), and the two functor identities 1_A = GF and FG = 1_B require a multline computation with functoriality, preservation of idtoiso and the triangle identity (lines 725-750). The reverse direction rebuilds full faithfulness through a second comparison map G-bar (lines 752-777), and the two round trips are not symmetric: the object parts are recovered in one direction while the other needs the equivalence of the two triangle identities (lines 779-795). The statement records none of the transport bookkeeping along eta_0 and eps_0 that the proof depends on.
